scope: One owned State parameter with two declared binders and exactly two selected direct fields; declarations remain distinct even when both actual ClosureIds coincide.

Static ordinary bare calls infer one unique complete T from actual value constraints; explicit TypeApply still checks its exact supplied T; empty without a unique value constraint and template values remain rejected.

Declaration source follows complete nominal/phantom T, fields, local moves, Store and existing union sides; no capture, opaque-return or function-pointer erasure of the new declaration source is opened.

Private bounded alias records preserve actual parent, borrow kind, fresh identity, ancestry and irreversible invalidation; runtime ownership and loans are still checked independently by Analyze/Verify.

rust_goals.compile_cost: Recorded legacy exact limits are unchanged; new work has measured N/N-1/fresh limits. No compile-speed/Rust performance comparison is claimed.
rust_goals.breakthrough: This is an executable language-composition increment, not a product-level net breakthrough. Full 1.4 remains NotSatisfied; B0 Doing and product/native Windows NotRun are unchanged.
